requirements.evidence: Contract is implemented end to end: routes/api.php:7-12, pairing transaction in app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemAuthController.php:27-59, JWT in app/Support/TotemJwt.php:21-81, middleware in app/Http/Middleware/TotemAuth.php:25-55, endpoints in app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemQueueController.php:20-122, and issuance delegates to IssueTicket at TotemQueueController.php:111. Gaps: the 400 invalid_code_format path returns before the audit log (TotemAuthController.php:20-23), the command does not retry a colliding unique code (TotemPairingCode.php:31-33), and queue description is always null (TotemQueueController.php:38).

conventions.evidence: The main domain write reuses App\Actions\IssueTicket (TotemQueueController.php:111); migrations are reversible with down() (database/migrations/2026_10_29_064717_create_totem_presets_table.php:22-33 and siblings); factories, fillable declarations, audit-channel logging and docs/CHANGELOG are present. Deviations: pairing consumes the code and creates the Totem inline in the controller/command instead of an app/Actions/* use case (TotemAuthController.php:28-52), and input checks are hand-rolled instead of $request->validate (TotemAuthController.php:20; TotemQueueController.php:102-106).

security.evidence: No exploitable weakness found: HS256 verification uses hash_equals, checks the header alg and exp (app/Support/TotemJwt.php:45-74); all three data routes sit behind totem.auth (routes/api.php:9-13); entity and queue scope are checked server-side (TotemQueueController.php:127-166); all token failures return the same 401 (TotemAuth.php:36-40); the full pairing code is never logged (TotemAuthController.php:56; TotemPairingCode.php:39); CORS is loopback-only with credentials disabled (config/cors.php:21-34).

tests.evidence: Broad Pest coverage: pairing success/format/unknown/expired/consumed/inactive/single-use/throttle (tests/Feature/TotemApiTest.php:35-113), token rejection/inactive rows/entity mismatch (115-160), heartbeat and entity slug (155-171), queue ordering/scope (173-211), priorities (213-238), issuance/priority/inactive/404/403/throttle (240-306), CORS (307-327), and the command (tests/Feature/TotemPairingCodeTest.php:8-38). Missing: audit-log assertions and unknown/missing totem_id/preset_id claims.

simplicity.evidence: Focused controllers, small support classes, and the ticket path delegates to IssueTicket (TotemQueueController.php:111). There is some duplication (the queues.id pluck appears in TotemAuthController.php:65 and TotemAuth.php:50) and dead code (TotemPriorities::values() at TotemPriorities.php:29).

readability.evidence: Names and docblocks are generally clear and methods are short. The priority mapping builds display order by passing array_keys(TotemPriorities::all()) as a parallel array and calls all() twice (TotemQueueController.php:67-79); the new Entity relations lack the generics/docblocks used by the new models (Entity.php:51,56).

scope.evidence: Every changed file serves the totem BFF task: .env/phpunit config, routes, bootstrap wiring, CORS, models/factories/migrations, JWT/middleware/controllers, docs, CHANGELOG and tests. No unrelated feature or refactor was added.

issues.explanation: The 400 invalid_code_format branch returns before any audit log, so malformed pairing attempts are not audited even though the task requires auditing pairing failures.

The generated code is saved without retrying if it collides with another preset's live login_code (the column is unique), which would surface as an unhandled QueryException; the factory guards uniqueness but the command does not.
description is hard-coded to null for every queue, so the contract field is never populated from queue data; the docs were changed to describe the null instead of sourcing a description.

Pairing (consuming the code and creating the Totem) is a domain write performed inline in the controller, and the command writes the preset directly, instead of following the project's one-class-per-use-case app/Actions/* pattern.
The new totems() and totemPresets() relations have no @return HasMany<...> docblock, and TotemJwt::ttl() (app/Support/TotemJwt.php:81) also lacks the PHPDoc the conventions ask for on public methods.
No test asserts the audit log for pairing success/failure or for the command, so the explicit audit requirement is unverified by the suite.
Tests cover inactive totem/preset rows but not a validly signed token whose totem_id or preset_id does not exist (or is missing), leaving the middleware's not-found branch untested.
The CORS test only exercises localhost and one disallowed origin; the 127.0.0.1 pattern and the TOTEM_WEB_ORIGIN branch in config/cors.php are not tested.
values() is never called anywhere in the change; it is dead code that can be removed.
The array_map computes visual order via a parallel array_keys(TotemPriorities::all()) argument and calls all() twice, which is harder to read than a simple indexed loop or values().

secret() rejects only an empty value, without enforcing the 32-character minimum promised in .env.example, and the login path lets the LogicException become a 500 instead of a controlled configuration failure.

review.summary: This change implements the totem BFF end to end: schema/models/factories, the totem:pairing-code command, HS256 JWT issuance and totem.auth middleware, the three queue/priority/ticket endpoints reusing IssueTicket, CORS, docs and a broad Pest suite. Security and contract handling are strong, but minor gaps remain: malformed pairing attempts are not audited, generated codes can collide without a retry, pairing writes bypass the Action pattern, and audit/unknown-claim cases lack tests. Overall 4 — approve with nits.
